description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kudawaskaduwa D/S Division, Kalutara D/S Division, Kalutara District - Cad. Map No. 530085
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, extents, owner names, and encumbrances) in the Kudawaskaduwa area. The content falls under "Land registrations, property ownership, land titles" as specified in the Land Gazettes (Type 4) category, and appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette.
